==Ansal Plaza, Delhi==
'''Ansal Plaza, Delhi''' is the oldest major [[shopping mall]] of [[Delhi]] as well as the third oldest in India. It was opened on 1 November 1999 with the launch of [[Shoppers Stop]] in Delhi (its first branch to be part of a mall, now [[Decathlon (retailer)|Decathlon Khel Gaon]]).<ref name='Ansal Plaza Delhi'/><ref>{{cite news|author=Pallavi Polanki|title=Delhi first learnt the mall experience here|url=http://www.hindustantimes.com/India-news/NewDelhi/Delhi-first-learnt-the-mall-experience-here/Article1-267696.aspx|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130125071022/http://www.hindustantimes.com/India-news/NewDelhi/Delhi-first-learnt-the-mall-experience-here/Article1-267696.aspx|url-status=dead|archive-date=25 January 2013|access-date=17 March 2012|newspaper=[[Hindustan Times]]|date=7 January 2008}}</ref> The mall was established by Ansal Properties & Infrastructure Ltd.<ref>{{cite web|title=Projects - Completed |url=http://www.ansalapi.com/projects/completed.aspx|archive-url=https://archive.today/20120718211748/http://www.ansalapi.com/projects/completed.aspx|url-status=dead|archive-date=18 July 2012|work=ansalapi.com|access-date=17 March 2012}}</ref> It is located at Andrews Ganj on Khel Gaon Marg, in [[South Delhi]] and has a gross leasable area of {{convert|178000|sqft|m2|abbr=on}}.<ref name='Ansal Plaza Delhi'>{{cite web|title=Ansal Plaza Delhi|url=https://www.indiaretailing.com/2016/11/11/shopping-centre/ansal-relaunches-flagship-shopping-mall-ansal-plaza-in-south-delhi/#aoh=15876580131192&referrer=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.com&amp_tf=From%20%251%24s}}</ref> The mall has an amphitheatre enclaved within the circular shaped plaza.<ref>{{cite news|title=Bazaar buzz: Ansal Plaza|author=Monica Sood|url=http://www.hindustantimes.com/StoryPage/Print/295693.aspx|access-date=17 March 2012|newspaper=Hindustan Times|date=14 September 2006}}{{dead link|date=August 2021|bot=medic}}{{cbignore|bot=medic}}</ref> It has parking facilities for 1000 cars.<ref>{{cite news|author=Kumarkaushalam|title=Ansal sets up new company for mall management |url=http://www.financialexpress.com/old/fe/daily/19991013/fst13062.html|archive-url=https://archive.today/20120730163355/http://www.financialexpress.com/old/fe/daily/19991013/fst13062.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=30 July 2012|access-date=17 March 2012|newspaper=Financial Express|date=13 October 1999}}</ref> After the success of '''Ansal Plaza, Delhi''', AIMS Ansals<ref>[http://www.ansalheights.co/ Ansal Heights]</ref> opened many more malls in several places of India.<ref>[http://www.ansals.com/ansal-plaza/index.asp Ansal Plaza] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120413154831/http://www.ansals.com/ansal-plaza/index.asp|date=13 April 2012}} Ansal Housing & Construction Limited.</ref>

==Ansal Crown Plaza, Faridabad==
'''Ansal Crown Plaza''' is one of the biggest malls of [[Faridabad]]. It is located on Mathura Road in Sector-15A and close to [[Neelam Chowk Ajronda metro station]]. It was launched in 2003 and has a gross leasable area of {{convert|300000|sqft|m2|abbr=on}}.<ref name='Malls in NCR'>{{cite web|title=Malls in NCR|url=http://www.asipac.com/uploaded/pdfFiles/1305803824Demand___Supply_of_Mall_Space_in_Delhi.pdf}}</ref>

==Ansal Plaza, Ludhiana==
'''Ansal Plaza, Ludhiana''' is located on Ferozepur Road in Gurdev Nagar, [[Ludhiana]]. It was opened in 2005 and has a gross leasable area of {{convert|250000|sqft|m2|abbr=on}}.<ref>{{cite web|title=Ansal Plaza Ludhiana|url=http://ludhianaonline.com/pages/ansal-plaza/}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Ansal Plaza Ludhiana Information|url=https://m.tribuneindia.com/2005/20051224/saturday/main1.htm}}</ref>

==Ansal Plaza, Ghaziabad==
'''Ansal Plaza, Ghaziabad''' was inaugurated in 2005 and it is one of the oldest malls of [[Ghaziabad]]. It is located near Dabur Chowk at [[Vaishali metro station|Vaishali]]. It has a gross leasable area of {{convert|200000|sqft|m2|abbr=on}}.<ref>{{cite web|title=Ansal Plaza Ghaziabad|url=https://delhi-ncr.mallsmarket.com/malls/ansal-plaza-vaishali}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Ansal Plaza Ghaziabad Information|url=http://www.ansals.com/commercial/ansal-plaza-ghaziabad/index.asp?links=hlp1|access-date=23 April 2020|archive-date=23 April 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210423085029/http://www.ansals.com/commercial/ansal-plaza-ghaziabad/index.asp?links=hlp1|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Ansal Plaza, Gurgaon==
'''Ansal Plaza, Gurgaon''' is located in Palam Vihar, an upscale locality of [[Gurgaon]]. The mall is close to Rezang La Chowk in Sector-23. It was launched in 2007 and has a gross leasable area of {{convert|260000|sqft|m2|abbr=on}}.<ref name='Malls in NCR'/>

==Ansal Royal Plaza, Jodhpur==
'''Ansal Royal Plaza''' was inaugurated in 2007 and it is one of the oldest malls of [[Jodhpur]]. It is located on High Court Road, close to Nai Sarak Chauraha. It has a gross leasable area of {{convert|136000|sqft|m2|abbr=on}}.<ref>{{cite web|title=Ansal Royal Plaza|url=https://www.cpkukreja.com/ansal-royal-plaza.html}}</ref>

==Ansal Highway Plaza, Sonipat==
'''Ansal Highway Plaza''' is located at Sector-62 in [[Kundli, Haryana|Kundli]], [[Sonipat]]. It was opened in 2008 and has a gross leasable area of {{convert|250000|sqft|m2|abbr=on}}.<ref>{{cite web|title=Ansal Highway Plaza|url=https://www.propertywala.com/ansal-highway-plaza-sonipat-sonipat}}</ref>

==Ansal Plaza, Greater Noida==
'''Ansal Plaza, Greater Noida''' is the first [[shopping mall]] of [[Greater Noida]]. It is located at [[Pari Chowk metro station|Pari Chowk]] in Amit Nagar. The mall was inaugurated in 2009 and has a gross leasable area of {{convert|750000|sqft|m2|abbr=on}}.<ref>{{cite web|title=Ansal Plaza Greater Noida|url=https://ofcspc.com/ansal-plaza-pari-chowk-greater-noida/|access-date=24 April 2020|archive-date=21 September 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200921125844/https://ofcspc.com/ansal-plaza-pari-chowk-greater-noida/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
